source: Semantic probe set (hand-built 2026-09-21) for the embedding-model switch gate: queries whose answer depends on the vector lane (category / paraphrase / peer-of-X retrieval) rather than on an exact name or an id. kind=labeled entries carry an explicit expected entity; kind=structural entries have no GT and can only be reviewed through the lane counters and a human read of the answer.

cases.query: 深圳有哪些做具身智能的公司
cases.note: The replay gate's G7 flagship (优必选 must appear in every repetition). Sibling companies seen in the frozen answer — 众擎, 乐聚, 越疆 — are NOT scored: they are the web lane's luck, not frozen GT.
Bare category phrasing, no enumerating frame — the case the topical floor was built for. Structural: no GT.
Peer-of-X paraphrase (G5 shape). The anchor must survive into the answer; the peers themselves are not frozen GT.

cases.query: 深圳有哪些人形机器人公司
cases.note: Category + product-form paraphrase. Structural: no GT.

cases.query: 深圳的灵巧手厂商有哪些
cases.note: From test-set turn q14t1's frozen answer (自变量机器人科技（深圳）有限公司, X Square 五指灵巧手). Category query whose only route to a local company is the vector lane.

cases.query: 做具身智能数据采集的公司

cases.query: 深圳有什么具身智能创业公司

cases.query: 和越疆科技类似的公司
cases.note: Peer-of-X where X is a local KB company (越疆 is named in G5's accepted set, so it is not frozen GT for the switch). Structural: no GT.

cases.query: 深圳做医疗机器人的企业有哪些
cases.note: Category query whose expected company is carried by test-set 问题10 (血管介入手术机器人).
